sourceCalendarName: St. Vrain Valley Schools 2025-2026 Academic Calendar
seoTitle: St. Vrain Valley Schools Calendar 2025-2026 | Dates & PDF
seoDescription: View the SVVSD 2025-2026 calendar with staggered August start dates, 174 contact days, seven PLC late starts, breaks, non-student days, and graduations.
heroSummary: St. Vrain Valley Schools begins grades 1-5, 6, and 9 on August 13, 2025; grades 7-8 and 10-12 on August 14; kindergarten on August 15; and preschool on August 18. The last student day is May 21, 2026. The calendar includes 174 contact days and seven 2.5-hour PLC late starts.
calendarNotes: The 2025-26 calendar distinguishes 12 non-student contact days: five teacher full workdays, four compensation days related to evening parent conferences, and three split workdays. Conference dates and times are school-specific. If the calendar must change, the Board may use Saturdays, scheduled breaks, or days after the published calendar as makeup dates.

customSections.label: Which Students Start on Each Date
customSections.content: SVVSD uses four opening dates rather than a single districtwide first day. Families should match the date to the student's grade and program.

customSections.label: 2025-26 PLC Late-Start Dates
customSections.content: These are attendance days, not closures. All students begin 2.5 hours later while staff participate in collaborative professional development.

calendarFaqs.q: When does St. Vrain Valley Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1-5, 6, and 9 start August 13; grades 7-8 and 10-12 start August 14; kindergarten starts August 15; and preschool starts August 18.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the SVVSD 2025-26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 174 student contact days: 85 in the first semester and 89 in the second.
